en: Mount Apo is the highest mountain in the Philippines, reaching an elevation of exactly 2,954 meters above sea level.
The Philippine flag features a sun with eight rays, representing the first eight provinces that revolted against Spanish colonial rule.
The Philippine Congress is a bicameral legislature composed of 24 Senators and more than 300 members in the House of Representatives.
Although the Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, Filipino and English serve as the country's two official national languages.
National hero Jose Rizal wrote his two famous novels, Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo, before his execution at age 35.
The colorful Sinulog Festival in Cebu is celebrated every third Sunday of January to honor the holy child Jesus.
The T'boli weavers of South Cotabato use three primary colors, specifically red, black, and white, to create their sacred T'nalak cloth.
Dr. Fe del Mundo made history in 1933 by becoming the first Asian admitted to Harvard Medical School.
National Artist Juan Luna painted the massive Spoliarium, a canvas measuring exactly 4.22 meters wide and 7.01 meters high.
The Philippine eagle, which is the national bird, stands about one meter tall and possesses a two-meter wingspan.
Under Philippine election laws, a citizen must be at least 18 years old to vote in national and local elections.
The Philippines is a vast archipelago composed of exactly 7,641 islands, according to the latest official national mapping survey.
